sqlMap.insert:
INSERT INTO T_MAP(MAP_ID, POSX, POSY, TYPE, STATE, TARGET_ID, CATEGORY) VALUES(#mapID#, #posX#, #posY#, #type#, #state#, #targetID#, #category#)
SELECT @@IDENTITY AS ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_MAP SET CATEGORY=#category# WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
UPDATE T_MAP SET TARGET_ID=#targetID#, CATEGORY=#category# WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
UPDATE T_MAP SET MAP_ID=#mapID#, POSX=#posX#, POSY=#posY#, TYPE=#type#, STATE=#state#, TARGET_ID=#targetID#, CATEGORY=#category# WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE MAP_ID NOT IN (SELECT M.MAP_ID FROM T_MAP M, T_DEPOY_QUEUE DQ WHERE M.MAP_ID=DQ.MAP_ID) AND STATE=1 AND CATEGORY=4
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE TARGET_ID=#tagetID# AND CATEGORY=#category#
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MAP WHERE TYPE>=10 AND TYPE<20 AND (CATEGORY=3 OR CATEGORY=4)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MAP WHERE TYPE>=10 AND TYPE<20 AND CATEGORY=#category#
SELECT MAP_ID FROM T_MAP WHERE TYPE>=10 AND TYPE<20 AND CATEGORY=3
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE POSX>=#startX# AND POSX<=#endX# AND POSY>=#startY# AND POSY<=#endY# AND CATEGORY=#category# ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE POSX>=#startX# AND POSX<=#endX# AND POSY>=#startY# AND POSY<=#endY#
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE POSX=#posX# AND POSY=#posY#
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE TYPE>=10 AND TYPE<20 AND CATEGORY=3

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE (POSX*POSX+POSY*POSY)>#radius#*#radius# AND (POSX*POSX+POSY*POSY)<(#radius#+#range#)*(#radius#+#range#)
